trending.desc: 微软出品的文件→Markdown 转换工具：支持 PDF/PPTX/DOCX/Excel/图片(OCR)/音频/YouTube URL/HTML/CSV 等几乎所有格式。Python，MIT 协议，免费开源。已支持 MCP server，可直接集成 Claude Desktop
trending.reason: 接近 10 万 star 里程碑持续热榜。MCP server 集成让 AI 应用能直接读取任意格式文件，「所有文件都是 Markdown」的 LLM 管道思路正在成为标准
trending.usage: pip install markitdown，支持 CLI 和 Python API；MCP server 可集成 Claude Desktop；⚠️ 需要 Python 环境，非直接可安装 skill，relevant=false
trending.repo_desc: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
trending.how_to_install:
To install MarkItDown, use pip: `pip install 'markitdown[all]'`. Alternatively, you can install it from the source:

```bash
git clone git@github.com:microsoft/markitdown.git
cd markitdown
pip install -e 'packages/markitdown[all]'
```
trending.how_to_use:
### Command-Line

```bash
markitdown path-to-file.pdf > document.md
```

Or use `-o` to specify the output file:

```bash
markitdown path-to-file.pdf -o document.md
```

You can also pipe content:

```bash
cat path-to-file.pdf | markitdown
```
